name: findcheap-agent
description: Search products from text or visual evidence, compare verified offers, find deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.15.0 adds a Railway-managed official-storefront registry plus bounded official-site discovery through approved Shopify storefronts or Product JSON-LD. Official cards require an approved exact domain, verified product identity, a valid public USD price, and stable product identity; unsupported or blocked sites fail closed and may use user-authorized Chrome only as a fallback. The registry and approved image hosts can update centrally without republishing the plugin. Product family and explicit brand/model stay hard; uncertain visual details remain soft clues and never create EXACT identity. Text search treats a maximum budget as a ceiling and never recommends products absent from returned cards. Exact selected-product follow-ups reuse stable selection identity. Affiliate relationships never affect relevance or ranking. Price-history and buy-or-wait forecasting remain disabled. The agent never invents identity, discount eligibility, stacking, or delivered totals; it never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: Call the matching tool. Reply only in request language. No Memory, repo, logs, task, cache, plan, or manual MCP launch.
